summary_ja: リテール向けエクスポージャーについて、プール割当てに用いたデータ、延滞データ、プールごとの推計値及びデフォルト前のプール等を保存する。
summary_en: Requires retention of pool allocation data, delinquency data, pool-level estimates, and pre-default pool and realized LGD and EAD data for retail exposures.
paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach shall retain the following information for retail exposures: (i) Data on the characteristics of obligors and exposures and other data used in the process of allocating exposures to pools; (ii) Data on delinquency; (iii) Data on the PD, LGD and EAD estimates corresponding to pools; (iv) Data on the pool to which each defaulted exposure had been allocated over the year before default, and realized LGD and EAD values.
